articles.title: Microsoft's Brad Smith pushes Big Tech to 'pay our way' for AI data centers amid rising opposition
articles.mainIdea: Microsoft's Brad Smith pushes Big Tech to 'pay our way' for AI data centers amid rising opposition
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Microsoft's Brad Smith pushes Big Tech to 'pay our way' for AI data centers amid rising opposition. It won’t be easy for Big Tech companies to win the hearts and minds of Americans who are angered about massive artificial intelligence data centers sprouting up in their neighborhoods, straining electricity grids and drawing on local reservoirs. Microsoft is trying anyway. The software giant's president, Brad Smith, is meeting with federal lawmakers Tuesday to push forward an approach that calls for the industry, not taxpayers, to pay the full costs of the vast network of computing warehouses needed to power AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Microsoft's own Copilot. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, GOOG, MSFT.
